name: DSX-CA1 Content Agent — Tue/Thu/Sat
notes: Updated 2026-09-17: this workflow used to compute its own topic_seed (a dead GameSradar RSS feed with a hardcoded 'GTA 6 latest news' fallback, verbatim first-headline-found with no dedup) and pick article_type purely by day-of-week. It now just pulls the next human-APPROVED topic from topic_queue (see src/agents/discovery/ + the Topic Queue section on /dashboard/content) -- article_type and template are now intrinsic to the approved topic, not the day. If topic_queue is empty (nothing approved yet), the run is a no-op, not a failure -- populate the queue from the dashboard before this cron fires. Triggers Tue/Thu/Sat at 9am MST (16:00 UTC), same cadence as before. Vars required: DECODEDSIX_API_URL, DECODEDSIX_API_KEY.
